title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: preview content in alerts without creating a case
summary: The roadmap facts, alert-access controls and documented preview limitations are supported. The assertion that the first content review previously required a case is not established by the sources. Minor corrections should name the product licence and reconcile the governance checklist with the controls table.

claims.claim: The roadmap announces previewing relevant files in an alert's Activity explorer with appropriate permissions, without creating a case.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management is excited to announce the ability to preview content directly within an IRM alert without having to create a case. Users with appropriate permissions will be able to preview relevant files referenced directly within activity explorer in each alert.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The precise role groups or additional permissions required for Content preview are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management content preview permissions roles investigators analysts. Read permissions and activities; the table distinguishes alert access and Content Explorer, but has no Content preview row or explicit mapping.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrative units restrict administrators' access to Insider Risk Management settings, policies and user data.
claims.quote: After you assign admin units to members of role groups, those members become restricted administrators and have limited access to Insider Risk Management settings, policies, and user data in the organization.

claims.claim: Restricted administrators cannot access alerts for users assigned through security or distribution groups added in administrative units.
claims.quote: Restricted administrators can't access alerts for the users assigned to them through security groups or distribution groups added in administrative units.

claims.claim: Content preview is a reviewer content-reading action.
claims.quote: For supported activities, investigators can preview related content directly within Activity explorer to quickly validate risk without creating a case.

claims.claim: Confirming an alert, creating a case and dismissing an alert are separate from reviewing its content preview.
claims.quote: Act on the alert. You can either confirm and create a case for an alert or dismiss and resolve the alert.

claims.claim: No autonomous action is described for Content preview.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management content preview autonomous automatic actions. Read activities' Content preview and triage steps; preview is described as investigators reviewing content, not as an autonomous action.
